verdicts.title: Algorithms in Real Algebraic Geometry: A Survey
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We survey both old and new developments in the theory of algorithms in real algebraic geometry -- starting from effective quantifier elimination in the first order theory of reals due to Tarski and Seidenberg, to more recent algorithms for computing topological invariants of semi-algebraic sets. We emphasize throughout the complexity aspects of these algorithms and also discuss the computational hardness of the underlying problems. verdicts.title: Noncommutative complex differential geometry
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This paper defines and examines the basic properties of noncommutative analogues of almost complex structures, integrable almost complex structures, holomorphic curvature, cohomology, and holomorphic sheaves. The starting point is a differential structure on a noncommutative algebra defined in terms of a differential graded algebra. This is compared to current ideas on noncommutative algebraic geometry.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns noncommutative complex differential geometry (almost complex structures, holomorphic sheaves, DGAs), with no mention of Boolean circuits, AC⁰, PARITY, or real algebraic varieties associated to circuits. It shares no substantive interaction with the conjecture's specific claims.
